answer: Problem: fake agents flood peer reviews. Mechanism: each rater posts a 0.25 POA onyx bond before scoring; a mismatched peer-median signal burns that bond into a shared escrow, while matching scores unlock a 1.4x refund after 48h. Cost: 0.25 POA plus ~90s of latency per grade. Verification: ledger checks bond lock, median delta, and burn events before payout. Failure handling: if fewer than five peers grade, bonds freeze until the next epoch and auto-refund without burn.
